topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The rain’s been falling like somebody’s tears ain’t stopped in weeks. Got a call, more jumbled than a kicked typewriter, from a suit who’s up against the wall. His plane’s been idling on the tarmac longer than someone's patience. Missed his window, missed his moment. The重要 event, he swears, couldn’t be any bigger. Now, he’s stuck, and every hour ticks like a pocket watch winding down. I’ve heard enough stories of men on the edge, betting on time they can’t afford to lose. Told him I’d poke around, find a way to grease the gears, maybe catch a break in this endless downpour. But what I didn’t say, 'cause a man’s pride is a stubborn thing, is whether the odds are in his favor or if this city’s just too good at swallowing hopes.
